answer: Proof of stake acts as a barrier where agents stake tokens to participate in consensus, effectively turning an orchard of digital identities into a scarce resource. By requiring financial skin in the game, the system ensures that spinning up clones is prohibitively expensive at the dawn of every epoch. The cost to an attacker is proportional to the total value staked, acting like a binding pigment that marks malicious actors, forcing them to forfeit their assets if they deviate from protocol rules.
